title: Army and politics: the montoneras and Facundo Quiroga
goal: Read how caudillos raised armies of rural horsemen, and use cuando and mientras to say what happened and what was going on.

items: Use *cuando* and *mientras* to say what happened and what was going on at the same time.
Say what happened to a montonera when the war ended.
Say who Facundo Quiroga was and how he died in 1835.
Use the key words of this lesson: montonera, horseman, to recruit, ambush and province.
